I specifically requested vaccinations for Hepatitis A, Typhoid, and Tetanus—all of which are listed as free travel vaccines on the official NHS website. Despite this, I was told the practice does not offer them, without any valid medical or legal reason.

According to the NHS, general practices must provide the following travel vaccines free of charge, as they are considered important for public health:

Hepatitis A

Typhoid

Tetanus/Diphtheria/Polio (combined booster)
